project_name: Complejo Ecoturístico Riviera Maya (Riviera Maya Ecotourism Complex)
filing_applicant: OLEUM JOINT VENTURE, S. DE R.L. DE C.V.
legal_property_owner_or_spv: OLEUM JOINT VENTURE, S. DE R.L. DE C.V. — Confirmed as legal property owner of the 70.57-hectare predio Punta Venado (folio real 156020, lote 003-2, manzana 2, Registro Público de la Propiedad y el Comercio de Quintana Roo). Purchased from Rosa María Joaquín Alcérreca (Ortega Joaquín family) for $19,414,518 USD via compraventa con reserva de dominio (2017), liberated in 2025.
ultimate_controlling_owner: Luis Francisco Serrano Lluch and Isidro Anguiano Campos — founders of Oleum Joint Venture, S. de R.L. de C.V. (incorporated 2014 in Tijuana, Baja California). Serrano Lluch also serves as legal representative. Foreign investment origin: United States.
primary_contact_company_contact_route: Oleum Joint Venture registered address: Av. Paseo de los Héroes 10093, Zona Urbana Río Tijuana, Tijuana, Baja California, 22010. Also appears to maintain operations in Cancún, Quintana Roo (based on employee LinkedIn profiles). No public company website or direct contact email identified. Legal representative Luis Francisco Serrano Lluch additionally associated with Fimubac SOFOM and Baja Cacho S.A. de C.V. (Tijuana-based). Business sector: support services for businesses / waste management and remediation.
dealality_stage: MIA Autorizada (Environmental Authorization Granted). Pre-Construction. SEMARNAT authorization published 07/MAY/2026 (Gaceta DGIRA/0022/26). 5.5-year construction window. No construction start reported. No brand/operator announced.
developer: OLEUM JOINT VENTURE, S. DE R.L. DE C.V. (mismo promovente). Posiblemente relacionada con Desarrolladora Oleum, S.A. de C.V. (entidad separada, sector energía/hidrocarburos, Cd. de México).
corridor_relationship_to_other_priority_: Adjacent/colindante but different ownership. Oleum's 70.57 ha predio (folio real 156020, Punta Venado/Punta Ina Xcaret) is adjacent to Proyecto Venado's 111-ha predio in the Punta Venado–Paamul corridor. Different promoventes: Oleum Joint Venture (Serrano Lluch/Anguiano Campos, Tijuana) vs. Residencial Punta Venado/Tortuga Resorts (KSL Capital + Rodina). No evidence of shared ownership, developer, or investor — purely geographic adjacency. Both authorized within ~6 weeks of each other (Apr/Jun 2026).
important_evidence_gaps: 1. Exact ownership split between Serrano Lluch and Anguiano Campos. 2. Verified direct contact for either founder. 3. Relationship between Oleum Joint Venture and Desarrolladora Oleum (CDMX, energy). 4. The 'Estados Unidos' foreign investment vehicle identity. 5. Whether there are additional investors beyond the two named founders. 6. Brand/operator decision status. 7. Isidro Anguiano Campos' role and background.
